notes.title: Nov. 23th Update news
notes.notes:
Hey hey,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29354241/2948a4999e0ee0b599601db26984fc323c37491e.png[/img]

Another cool update just came to Rento. Here is what is new:
[list]
[*]  "Deep board" bug fix - we fixed old problem where exiting inner circle always gave $200
[*]  Finally improved the TRADE screen. Now it is semi transparent and you can easily see card info by clicking on it and it also selects it in the map
[*] Houses can now be sold during an auction and during land purchase
[*]  Tournament bug fix
[*]  "Choose dice" screen made smaller to enable you to better see the map
[*]  Increased resolution of multiple images
[*]  Added sound effect for "Wheel of fortune" luck landings
[*] Settings panel bug fix
[*] Map names and prices small bug fixes
[*] Other stability and UI bug fixes
[/list]

Cheers

notes.title: Another New Update
notes.notes:
Hi folks,
Today we added another great update to Rento. 
Now you have the option to change your nickname as you want.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/21673518c7ca8b8ad27ab00bb060f4381d8e251a.jpg[/img]
The change is offered as paid microtransaction. We had to do it this way, to limit the amount of users who constantly change (or want to change) their nicknames.

Cheers

notes.title: Hot update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Today we released new Rento version in which you can find the following:
1) New Platform icons. Now you can see your opponents platform.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/3d8bdab38d9da47a303ffa007385865df8c33979.jpg[/img]
As you know, Rento Fortune is cross-platform multiplayer game and you can play vs players on Android, iOS, PS4, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, Windows 10 and WEB.

2) DUBAI and HAWAII are replaced with QATAR and CHINA to match with other  lands, which are countries (and not cities).

3) Immunity bug fix (The immunity used to work on next turn, although it should have been cancelled)

4) DONE button bug fix (Sometimes the button did not disappear, when it should have)

5) Timing achievements bug fix (Sometimes they were activated on games over 1 hour. Now it is fixed)

Please let us know if you find any problems

Cheers

notes.title: RENTO 4.4.4 - HUGE UPDATE !!!
notes.notes:
We are proud to show you our latest Rento improvements from today.
Three new LUCK cards are added:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/79ff16cd6cddee24bdf73a525a30987236e356d5.png[/img]

If you see this card - you will have the opportunity to select and destroy 1 opponent house. The tornado will blow it away.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/2a656b30f0ec55d3d9374a244d0b55386030409c.png[/img]

This card allow you to set one land where the Olympic games will be hosted. 
It will increase the land's rent by 50% for one pawn landing.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29354241/4330f906f49cc641a138232e5dd330376f6c8b28.png[/img]

This card is kept to you and you can use this immunity whenever you want (but before you roll the dice). Once you apply the immunity, you will not pay any rent for that turn.
Your immunity can be used once. 

P.S. It may take few hours while most people get the update so be patient

notes.title: Rento Update v4.3.5 What's New
notes.notes:
In today's update Rento 4.3.5 we added one major feature:
[h1] Cast to TV[/h1]
Rento can now be played on your TV.
In order to do that, follow this instructions:
[olist]
    [*]Install Rento to your mobile phones
    [*]Start a mobile online game with your friends or family
    [*]Connect your PC to your TV
    [*]Start Steam version on Rento and show it on your TV
    [*]On the first screen in Rento, click the "TV Cast" button and enter the code, which is displayed in your mobile in-game options menu
[/olist]

It is very easy to do, soon we will make a YouTube instructional video.
Cheers
